meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会在升级 NanoClaw 时先把你做的改动和原因整理成一份迁移指南，再在干净的新代码上重放这些改动，而不是用合并。
howto.when: 当你要求升级 NanoClaw 或把本地改动迁移到新版本时触发；若已有指南，会询问跳过提取直接升级。

say.text: 我要升级 NanoClaw，把本地定制带过去。
say.note: Claude 会先检查环境并分析改动范围。

say.text: 帮我生成一份迁移指南记录所有定制。
say.note: 会探索代码库、识别改动后用 markdown 写指南。

say.text: 已有迁移指南，直接升级就行。
say.note: 跳过提取阶段，进入重放改动升级环节。

howto.what_en: When upgrading NanoClaw, Claude inventories the user's local customizations and their intent into a replayable markdown guide, then checks out clean upstream in a worktree and reapplies those customizations — avoiding merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user requests an upgrade or migration of NanoClaw customizations. If a migration guide already exists, it offers to skip straight to upgrade.

say_en.text: Upgrade NanoClaw and bring my local customizations along.
say_en.note: Claude checks environment and assesses scope first.

say_en.text: Generate a migration guide recording all my customizations.
say_en.note: It explores the codebase and writes guide as markdown.

say_en.text: Use the existing guide and upgrade directly.
say_en.note: Skips extraction and goes to reapply changes.
